patternSignature.normalExpectation: Brushing untangles hair and smooths it.
patternSignature.declaredResponse: Each brush stroke creates a new knot, and the knots tighten the more you brush; hair eventually coils around the brush like a topiary.

objectRelationship: Brush bristles are meant to separate strands; if they weave strands together, brushing becomes tangling.
triggerRelationship: Opa brushes once, hair stands up in a giant knot.
goalInterference: The action of brushing makes hair worse, so smooth hair is impossible.
scope: EDITORIAL_ONLY; one admitted source is not evidence of recurrence or a reason to add a taxonomy label.
